patterns.note: Narrow, centered text content column for listings and descriptions, contrasted with full-width image carousel sections for visual impact.
Elegant serif font for prominent section headings paired with a clean, small sans-serif for body text, navigation, and labels.
A high-contrast scheme featuring black text on a very light, almost white background, with blue used sparingly for interactive links.
Image carousels are used within content sections, indicated by 'Current of X' pagination and explicit navigation arrows, powered by a library like Swiper.
Content is organized into distinct, vertically separated blocks: an initial search/listing area, followed by full-width image carousels, and a comprehensive footer.

technique_notes: The site employs a split content strategy, starting with a narrow, text-focused listing area, then transitioning to full-width visual sections. These visual sections feature large, single-image carousels (powered by Swiper) with clear navigation controls and descriptive text below.
No scroll-triggered reveals, parallax effects, or sticky elements are used; page content simply scrolls into view in a linear fashion without additional animation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Moderately sized serif headings (~2x body) with very small, legible sans-serif body text and labels, creating a refined but understated hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with generous vertical spacing between content blocks and list items, contributing to a minimal and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive quality lies in its stark contrast between an extremely minimal, almost directory-like initial presentation with small text and vast whitespace, and the subsequent introduction of large, full-width, high-quality image carousels. This blend creates an unexpected shift from functional listing to a more editorial, aspirational experience.
